_comment: Business details, navigation and site-wide toggles. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE.
js/config.js is generated from it, and the header nav, mobile drawer and
footer link columns on every page are rewritten from it by tools/content.js.
Run `npm run build` after editing. Never edit js/config.js by hand — it says
so at the top of the generated file, and your edit is overwritten.

social._comment: Published as schema.org sameAs. Empty values are skipped entirely, which is correct until a profile actually exists. Never point one at a platform's home page.

flags._demoNotice: Shows the 'sample listings' line in the footer of the directory and every microsite. Set false once data/lawyers.json holds real, consented advocates.
flags._showPricing: Renders the priced plan table on list-your-practice.html from data/pricing.json. Set false to go back to 'message us for the current figures'.

nav._comment: The primary nav and the mobile drawer, in order. `href` is a page in the repo root. Add, remove or reorder here and every page's header follows.

practiceAreas._comment: Generated from the categories in data/lawyers.json — add a category there and the column grows. `suffix` is appended to each category name.
practiceAreas.heading: Practice Areas

areas._comment: The locality chips. Each becomes lawyers.html?area=<name>, so the name must match `location.area` in data/lawyers.json exactly or the filter returns nothing. tools/content.js warns when one has no advocates.
areas.heading: Advocates by Area

sitemap._comment: The static pages, for sitemap.xml. tools/sync.js adds the category and advocate URLs itself. Add a page here when you add one, or it never gets submitted. 404.html and lawyer.html are deliberately absent — one is an error page, the other is a template with no content of its own.
